sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: A Bitter Victory is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Alright, well the smugglers managed to get their commander out, though not without losses. I'm heading over to talk things through and ask about you as well. But you get it, right now they need to both celebrate the win and properly remember the ones they lost. So I can't show up empty-handed. You gonna help set the table?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Hand over 2 Bottles of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to the BTR Driver
  - (Optional) Obtain 2 Bottles of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
- Hand over 4 Rye croutons to the BTR Driver
  - (Optional) Obtain 4 Rye croutons
- Hand over 4 Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka to the BTR Driver
  - (Optional) Obtain 4 Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka
- Hand over 2 Salty Dog beef sausages to the BTR Driver
  - (Optional) Obtain 2 Salty Dog beef sausages
- Talk to the BTR Driver
- Survive and extract from the location

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +30,000 EXP
"That's a decent haul of grub you brought. With stuff like this, the conversation will go a lot easier. By the next time we meet, I should have something for you about your request."
